entities.name: Álvaro Salvadores
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Álvaro Salvadores Salvi was a Chilean-Spaniard basketball player who competed at the 1950 FIBA World Championship in the Spain national team, and at the 1952 Summer Olympics in the Chile men's national team. Salvadores was also Chile's ambassador to Colombia, from 1986 to 1988. One of his younger brothers, Luis Salvadores, was a basketball player.
